articles.title: New Zealand Cricket ropes in Hero Vida as title sponsor for India-New Zealand series
articles.summary: Hero Vida has become the title sponsor for India's 12-match cricket tour of New Zealand. This significant sponsorship coincides with a major milestone: both nations are celebrating 100 years of sporting ties. This collaboration underscores strong bilateral relations through sports and showcases Indian corporate engagement on an international platform, marking a century of friendly competition.
